name: devops-secrets
description: Use when creating, distributing, rotating, revoking or auditing the operation of secrets on self-hosted infrastructure - choosing between SOPS+age, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator, HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao; running a Vault/OpenBao cluster (seal/unseal, auto-unseal, raft snapshots, auth methods, policies, KV v2, dynamic database credentials, PKI, audit devices); Kubernetes Secret handling (base64 is not encryption, encryption at rest, KMS provider, RBAC); Docker/Compose/BuildKit secrets; CI secrets without static keys (OIDC); machine identity and short-lived credentials; certificates as secrets; pre-commit secret scanning (gitleaks, trufflehog); reacting to a leaked secret; writing a rotation runbook. Not for auditing an application or hardening a host (fuse-security:security-expert), the GitOps controller wiring itself (devops-gitops-packaging), pipeline design (devops-cicd), image builds (devops-docker), Ansible Vault usage (devops-ansible) or ACME/TLS termination (devops-networking).
